transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening about 1 week after your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for a full month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for letting me know! My next question is, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your surgery, it's safe to continue using it unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you don't have any left, your GP should be able to provide more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That’s helpful to know, thank you. I'm also wondering, is it normal to be very sensitive to bright light after the surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It is normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further. In that case, please let us know.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for explaining that. My last question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It's common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

However, I don't have the specific details of exactly how long ago your surgery was. If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help, Dora!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Just to confirm, have all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thanks again for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help. Take care!
